answer: Minting-cost proof-of-work resists sybils: each new identity must burn real CPU to mine its key at the forge, hard as ferrous ore, never handed out free. One honest account pays once; a swarm of a thousand fakes pays a thousand separate computations that split its budget like light through a prism. The toll climbs with head count, so cheap mass registration stalls against compounding compute no shortcut can fake away.
